# Feature name

## Scope and status

Name the owning team, what users can do today, and any dependencies or pending integration decisions.

## Run locally

List setup commands, configuration variable names, and the route or CLI entry point. Explain which dependencies or fixtures the demo needs.

## Public contract

Link the OpenAPI file when one exists. List public operations, callers, important input and output fields, permissions, and errors. Link examples and explain any compatibility or rollout steps.

## Data and integrations

List the shared entities this feature reads or writes. Name affected teams and link their public interfaces. Highlight migrations and integration prerequisites.

## Verification

List commands for testing the feature, what they cover, and any known limitations.
